items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Interviewer identifies 'Doris Eaton' in a photo; Interviewee does not mention her or claim a personal relationship.

ctx.x: What a nice show that was, too. Let's see, we go on back here.
There's another picture of the... Yeah, it's Ada's band outside the Coconut Grove. Coconut Grove, yeah. This is Doris Eaton.

This is Wesley Barry. Remember the little kid movie song? Oh, yeah. Yeah, there's Wesley. Mm-hmm. This is the Charlie Pierce we were talking about. Oh, yeah. See, he's got a stage. He's got a piano player. He's got a song with a saxophone, a fishing one. Oh, yeah. There's some nice pictures. This is my old man. That's your family, your father, yeah.
